description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit a crop or production plan record with the planting, input application and harvest records it answers to: the plan with its reference, the version on file, the season, the operation and the fields it lists; each crop the plan names with its id, reference, the crop, the variety and the field it is planned on; each input the plan calls for with its id, reference, the product and the crop; each planting record with its id, reference, field, crop, the plan version it cites and the moment planted; each input application record with its id, reference, field, product, the plan version it cites and the moment applied; each harvest record with its id, reference, field, crop, the plan version it cites and the moment harvested. The signed report gives the plan and the crops, each crop the plan names against a planting record behind it, each field the planting and harvest records name against the fields the plan lists, each input application against the inputs the plan calls for, and the plan version on file against the version every record cites, and counts them, and names divergent crop plan records: a crop the plan names with no planting record behind it, a field in the planting or harvest records that the plan does not list, an input application the plan does not call for, and a plan version on file that the operation’s other records do not match; then a planting record naming a crop the plan does not name and an input the plan calls for with no application record behind it, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No crops, crops with no planting records beside them, no field list beside records that name a field, no inputs beside applications, or no plan version beside records that cite one leaves those points unverified. Fields, records and versions match by letters and digits, crops match by their words with plurals folded and read on the field the plan sets when it sets one, the fields the plan lists are its field list and the fields its crops are planned on, and inputs match by product name without case or punctuation. This reads the crop plan as a whole against the planting, input application and harvest records behind every crop, field and input it names. Verdict agri_crop_plan_divergent, agri_crop_plan_partial, agri_crop_plan_unverified or agri_crop_plan_consistent. POST /api/agri-crop-plan-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
